**The build passes now.** You were right, two warnings were real bugs.

1. The bumped bundler renamed `retries` to `retryCount`. `src/core/options.js` still read the old name.
2. Unset flags now arrive as `undefined`, not `false`. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw on that.

The 8 remaining warnings name files not in this repo. Nothing to fix here.
